attach-occurrence: The kind and key fingerprint match. attachEvidence adds the new occurrence to the open question.
answer-attached: A person answers with the current onEvidence. A rule answers only if its clause matches and heldOpen is false.
answer-first: A new question may settle immediately. An extra occurrence is optional.
carry-forward: stillHolds requires every HoldTerm to hold. noteCarried increments the occurrence count; no new question is created.
carry-again: Carried is a raise result. The stored question remains decided; the same decision continues to cover later occurrences.
hold-ends: At the next raise, basis-changes, this-target, time or fact-gone can end the hold. Revert the effect and open epoch + 1 with prior linked.
first-hold-ends: The first later occurrence may already be outside the hold, without a carried occurrence first.
answer-new-epoch: The new question follows the same policy and settlement path. Its decision can supersede the prior question's decision.
undo-decision: A permitted person withdraws an undoable decision. The new withdrawn row supersedes the old decision; both stay in the ledger.
answer-after-undo: heldOpen prevents a rule from immediately restoring an answer that a person withdrew on unchanged evidence.
time-sweep: The periodic sweep reopens the existing question, rather than creating a new epoch. The gate is pending when a relied-on hold expires and blocked after the sweep refolds it.
answer-after-sweep: The question is open again. answer or a later raise follows the normal policy path.
new-evidence-removes-cause: Only an open failure question may dissolve, and only the newest run in that scope may dissolve it.
new-epoch-removes-cause: The newest run no longer has the signature in its failing set. The question and all its history remain.
cause-returns: A cause that returns after dissolution gets the next epoch through raise. Dissolution does not erase the question.
